properties.description:
The `unallocated_component` gap: leaf Components carrying zero incoming ALLOCATED_TO, reported as ONE aggregate rollup rather than one alarm per box.

Excludes any component holding a child Component — a parent is allocated through its children. Silent when the design has no capabilities, because there is then no allocation to have performed and that phase belongs to `concept_without_design`. Distinguishes NEVER STARTED (nothing allocated anywhere — the deferred allocation step never picked back up) from PARTIAL, because those are acted on differently. Aggregate-keyed so the standing judgement "our boxes are namespaces, not functional parts" survives somebody adding a component.

The mirror of `unallocated_capability`, and the visible half of the answer to `dec:idea-does-the-deferred-structuring-step-need-a-skill-of-its-own`.
properties.name: Report leaf components no capability is allocated to
